important_rule: All price levels in historical_research are stale research notes, not current market data. Current entries/exits must always be recalculated from fresh prices.runescape.wiki relay data.

theses.what_we_know: Jagex's July 30, 2026 Fractured Archive rewards blog says the Breaker will require Ascension Shards plus a rune of some kind and explicitly says the rune had not been decided at that time.
theses.what_we_think: Wrath is a plausible candidate because it is a high-level rune with limited current sinks, but there is no official Wrath-specific confirmation.

theses.what_we_know: Implemented August 12, 2026. Arcane and Dexterous weights changed from 20/69 old weighting to 14/60 regular and 12/56 CM, summarized by Jagex as about 20% less common in regular CoX and 26% less common in CM.
theses.what_we_think: Supply is structurally improved for scrolls, but inventories and seller behavior can delay or overpower the fundamental effect.

theses.what_we_know: Implemented August 12, 2026. Each Ancestral piece weight changed from 3/69 to 4/60 regular and 4/56 CM; Jagex table describes +53.3% relative weighting regular and +64.3% CM.
theses.what_we_think: This is a structural supply headwind even if short-term price can rebound on positioning or future magic demand.
failure_modes: new content raises demand faster than supply

theses.what_we_know: The Fractured Archive Breaker proposal is a Crush megarare designed to dominate large Crush-weak targets; Jagex also proposed lowering Nex Crush defence so Breaker becomes BiS there. Rondache is a Crush-based shield-bash off-hand with Avernic-like Strength but no accuracy and Jagex mentioned a possible future combination path with Avernic if needed.
theses.what_we_think: Crush relevance can rise while the Inquisitor mace loses relative weapon share. Armor may benefit differently from mace, so the ecosystem must be analyzed piece-by-piece.
failure_modes: Crush bosses do not use Inquisitor set effectively

theses.what_we_know: No confirmed new sink or upgrade path has been identified. The item has shown thin-market spikes and reversals.
theses.what_we_think: Any future magic progression recipe or component requirement could matter because of low unit value, but current thesis is speculative.

theses.what_we_know: Fractured Archive proposal includes Zeal requiring 84 Prayer plus Piety, 75 Attack and 75 Strength if implemented as proposed. This creates a potential high-level Prayer demand narrative, but it does not itself create a direct bone sink.
theses.what_we_think: Prayer training demand can front-run major prayer unlocks, but bone supply and alternative training methods matter.

theses.what_we_know: Jagex's July 30 Fractured Archive proposal says Ascension Crossbows use regular, Diamond, or Onyx Ascension bolts, and Ascension bolts are made from Ascension Shards. The blog does not state that existing Diamond or Onyx bolt tips are ingredients.
theses.what_we_think: Existing gem-tip items could benefit only if Jagex uses them in the recipe or if substitution demand emerges. This is not confirmed.
